mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns in declining rate periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing output (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a supply shock that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of INDPRO < 100 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts consistently signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST trend falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 5-day returns in rising HOUST periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When CPI exceeds 205, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of CPIAUCSL > 205 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment and decreases in unemployment indicate a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During negative GDP growth periods (GDPC1 annualized growth < 0), economic contraction reduces corporate revenue and investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of GDPC1 growth < 0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
